task.description: Clone the MainStage Vision website (https://mainstage.vision/index.html) including all sections and interactive features.

completed_steps.step: Authenticated and configured environment for Next.js 16 + Tailwind CSS + shadcn/ui.
Implemented core layout components: Navigation (with active state) and Footer.
Created comprehensive `lib/api.ts` to fetch real data (News, Events, Albums, Videos, Artists) from the MainStage API.

Developed all main pages with client-side filtering and search: - **Home**: Hero, Recent News, Recent Albums, Events Sidebar. - **Events**: Filter by Type, Province, Country, Date. Upcoming/Past tabs. - **News**: Filter by Category, Search. - **Albums**: Filter by Event, Search. - **Videos**: Filter by Event, Search, Video Player embed. - **Artists**: A-Z Filter, Genre Filter, Search.
Implemented dynamic detail pages for all content types (`[id]` routes) with rich layouts and related content.
Styled all components using Tailwind CSS to match the original "MainStage" dark aesthetic (Pink #e91e63 accent).
Verified functionality with a browser walkthrough.

next_steps.step: Run `npm run build` to generate the production build (verified passing).
Run `npm run start` to serve the application locally.
